title: Self-serve Audit Readiness: DPA Builder, Residency Selector, and Retention Timeline
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Deliver a self-serve workflow in the Console that lets customers: 1) generate a DPA draft tailored to selected data residency jurisdictions, 2) configure retention and deletion timelines at workspace and route-level granularity, and 3) produce a machine-readable audit timeline (exportable bundle) that traces policy change history and evidence artifacts. This ticket covers the product PRD, acceptance criteria, and go/no-go pilot plan for the first-stage MVP (EU/US residency and token-level retention settings).
acceptance_criteria: Console flow exists where a customer can pick one or more residency regions and see a preview DPA with region-specific clauses
Retention configuration UI supports workspace defaults, route-level overrides, and a human-readable timeline preview
Exportable audit bundle includes: selected residency settings, retention policy versions, signed DPA PDF, and links to evidence artifacts (logs, key rotation events)
Generated artifacts include version metadata so Console can show a changelog and immutable snapshots
MVP validated with 2 pilot customers and internal legal review sign-off
tasks: Write PRD: scope, non-goals, edge cases, and compliance personas
Design: mockups for Residency Selector, Retention Timeline, and Export Bundle UX
Backend: API endpoints for policy templates, policy versioning, and export bundle generation
Runtime: ensure retention enforcement hooks are plumbed to storage/ingress paths and documented for Dedicated/Private
Legal: produce base DPA clauses for US, EU, and UK; flag statements requiring customer input
CLI/SDK: add export-audit-bundle command for programmatic retrieval
Analytics: add events to track policy changes and bundle exports
Pilot: run with 2 customers, collect feedback, produce go/no-go decision
